//go:build integration

package integration

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"os"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/infrastructure/persistence/postgres"
	publicapi "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/transport/http/api/v1"
	publichandlers "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/transport/http/api/v1/handlers"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/transport/http/middleware"
	privateapi "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/transport/http/private"
	privatehandlers "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/transport/http/private/handlers"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/usecase/hybridapplication"
	studentuc "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/usecase/student"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

// Root starts this finite provider against retained official T20.3 ingress.
// Snapshot reads, consequence applicability, atomic path mutation and receipts
// use actual registered Student handlers/usecases/PostgreSQL. The provider
// creates no initial or final evidence/mastery/path fixtures.
func TestT204HybridApplicationOwnerProvider(t *testing.T) {
	ready := os.Getenv("T204_OWNER_READY_FILE")
	if ready == "" {
		t.Skip("root-only actual Student application provider gate absent")
	}
	stop, eventFile, snapshotFile := os.Getenv("T204_OWNER_STOP_FILE"), os.Getenv("T204_OWNER_EVENT_FILE"), os.Getenv("T204_SNAPSHOT_FILE")
	token := os.Getenv("T204_OWNER_TOKEN")
	if stop == "" || eventFile == "" || snapshotFile == "" || token == "" {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: dedicated token and fresh control/snapshot paths required")
	}
	paths := []string{ready, stop, snapshotFile, eventFile}
	for i, path := range paths {
		for _, previous := range paths[:i] {
			if path == previous {
				t.Fatal("SETUP: all paths must be distinct")
			}
		}
		if path != eventFile {
			if _, err := os.Lstat(path); !os.IsNotExist(err) {
				t.Fatal("SETUP: output and stop files must be absent")
			}
		}
	}
	cfg, err := pgxpool.ParseConfig(os.Getenv("STUDENT_T20_DATABASE_URL"))
	if err != nil || cfg.ConnConfig.Host != "127.0.0.1" || cfg.ConnConfig.Port != 58999 || cfg.ConnConfig.Database != "remediation_t20_student_integration_proof" || cfg.ConnConfig.User != "postgres" || cfg.ConnConfig.TLSConfig != nil {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: exact isolated native Student database required")
	}
	raw, err := os.ReadFile(eventFile)
	if err != nil || len(raw) > domain.MaximumPlanningStateEventBytes {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: retained actual official owner event unavailable")
	}
	var envelope domain.EventEnvelope
	if json.Unmarshal(raw, &envelope) != nil {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: malformed actual owner event")
	}
	event := domain.IntegrationEvent{EventID: envelope.EventID, Subject: envelope.EventType, CorrelationID: envelope.CorrelationID, CausationID: envelope.CausationID, StudentID: envelope.StudentID, OccurredAt: envelope.OccurredAt, SchemaVersion: envelope.SchemaVersion, Payload: raw}
	if domain.ValidatePlanningStateChangedEvent(event) != nil {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: retained owner event contract mismatch")
	}
	var data domain.PlanningStateChangedData
	if json.Unmarshal(envelope.Data, &data) != nil {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: exact owner path/targets missing")
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 6*time.Minute)
	defer cancel()
	pool, err := pgxpool.NewWithConfig(ctx, cfg)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer pool.Close()
	var stored []byte
	if err := pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT payload::text FROM student_outbox WHERE event_id=$1 AND student_id=$2 AND subject=$3`, event.EventID, event.StudentID, event.Subject).Scan(&stored); err != nil {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: actual committed owner event missing")
	}
	canonical := func(raw []byte) []byte {
		var value any
		if json.Unmarshal(raw, &value) != nil {
			t.Fatal("SETUP: malformed event payload")
		}
		out, _ := json.Marshal(value)
		return out
	}
	if !bytes.Equal(canonical(stored), canonical(raw)) {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: exported event differs from committed owner fact")
	}
	journey := &postgres.LearningJourneyRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	getter := studentuc.GetPlanningSnapshot{Reader: journey}
	snapshot, err := getter.Handle(ctx, event.StudentID, data.LearningPathID, domain.PlanningSnapshotRequest{Targets: data.Targets, TriggerContext: domain.PlanningSnapshotTrigger{Kind: data.TriggerKind, Reason: "actual_T204_application_owner", CorrelationID: event.EventID}})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("actual coherent owner snapshot preflight: %v", err)
	}
	general, teacher := uuid.NewString(), uuid.NewString()
	if token == general || token == teacher {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: distinct scoped internal tokens required")
	}
	service := hybridapplication.Service{Applications: journey, Clock: t204ProviderClock{}}
	router := chi.NewRouter()
	router.Mount("/internal", privateapi.NewRouter(&privatehandlers.Handler{PlanningSnapshot: getter, HybridApplication: service}, general, token, teacher))
	public := chi.NewRouter()
	public.Use(middleware.AuthMiddleware{}.Middleware)
	publicapi.RegisterHybridIntentRoutes(public, &publichandlers.StudentHybridIntentHandler{Intents: service})
	router.Mount("/api/v1", public)
	// Read-only proof instrumentation for retained isolated owner UUIDs. Actual
	// application commands enter only the production registered private route.
	router.Get("/__t204/state", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		if r.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token") != token {
			w.WriteHeader(http.StatusUnauthorized)
			return
		}
		studentID, pathID := r.URL.Query().Get("student_id"), r.URL.Query().Get("path_id")
		if studentID == "" {
			studentID, pathID = event.StudentID, data.LearningPathID
		}
		if !domain.IsCanonicalPracticeLearningActionUUID(studentID) || !domain.IsCanonicalPracticeLearningActionUUID(pathID) {
			w.WriteHeader(http.StatusBadRequest)
			return
		}
		path, err := journey.GetLearningPathByID(r.Context(), studentID, pathID)
		if err != nil {
			w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNotFound)
			return
		}
		var revisions, applications, receipts, intents, intentEvents int
		if err := pool.QueryRow(r.Context(), `SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM student_learning_path_revision WHERE student_learning_path_id=$1),(SELECT count(*) FROM student_hybrid_application WHERE learning_path_id=$1),(SELECT count(*) FROM student_hybrid_application_receipt r JOIN student_hybrid_application a USING(consequence_id) WHERE a.learning_path_id=$1),(SELECT count(*) FROM student_learning_intent WHERE learning_path_id=$1),(SELECT count(*) FROM student_outbox WHERE subject='student.planning-state.changed.v1' AND payload->'data'->>'learning_path_id'=$1::text AND payload->'data'->>'trigger_kind'='LEARNING_INTENT')`, pathID).Scan(&revisions, &applications, &receipts, &intents, &intentEvents); err != nil {
			w.WriteHeader(http.StatusInternalServerError)
			return
		}
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{"path": path, "revisions": revisions, "applications": applications, "receipts": receipts, "intents": intents, "intent_events": intentEvents})
	})
	server := httptest.NewServer(router)
	defer server.Close()
	write := func(path string, value any) {
		t.Helper()
		raw, err := json.Marshal(value)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		file, err := os.OpenFile(path, os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREATE|os.O_EXCL, 0600)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		_, writeErr := file.Write(append(raw, '\n'))
		closeErr := file.Close()
		if writeErr != nil || closeErr != nil {
			t.Fatal("actual provider metadata export failed")
		}
	}
	write(snapshotFile, snapshot)
	write(ready, map[string]any{"url": server.URL, "token": token, "general_token": general, "teacher_token": teacher, "student_id": event.StudentID, "path_id": data.LearningPathID, "targets": data.Targets, "snapshot_ref": snapshot.References.SnapshotRef, "event_id": event.EventID, "classification": "actual registered Student snapshot/application HTTP/usecases/PostgreSQL; retained eight official evidence commits; no fixture state writes"})
	ticker := time.NewTicker(100 * time.Millisecond)
	defer ticker.Stop()
	for {
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			t.Fatal("actual Student provider stop not received before finite deadline")
		case <-ticker.C:
			if _, err := os.Lstat(stop); err == nil {
				return
			} else if !os.IsNotExist(err) {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
		}
	}
}

type t204ProviderClock struct{}

func (t204ProviderClock) Now() time.Time { return time.Now().UTC().Truncate(time.Microsecond) }
